entries.3bbe2ee63cfda124: With the mission of solving customers' issues by fusing people and technology, the company states that it will improve synergies among group companies in Japan and overseas and further promote globalization and the expansion of business areas. In its management strategies and other matters, the company states that, in domestic solutions, it sets out full-process support through group coordination and growth in the Tech field, a large market; in overseas solutions, improvement of profitability through rebuilding the business foundation; and that it will withdraw from the media and content business and allocate management resources to domestic software testing and development, overseas business expansion, efforts toward the AI transformation of operations, and other areas. The company states that, having finished its restructuring period, it will shift to a re-growth period, and in the next fiscal year it aims to record net income attributable to owners of the parent.
